Standards and Legislation

All standards and legislation referenced in both exam syllabi, sourced and supplied directly by Tseke. As an active Installation Rules lecturer and assessor, he confirms the correct current edition for your paper and delivers to your door. All SANS standards listed below are priced to include free delivery anywhere in South Africa. Pay securely through Yoco and Tseke will arrange dispatch. OHS Act 85 of 1993 is supplied by LexisNexis — place an order and Tseke will confirm pricing directly.

OHS Act 85 of 1993
Occupational Health and Safety Act with Electrical Installation Regulations and Electrical Machinery Regulations · Paper 1

Order: OHS Act 85 of 1993

SANS 10142-1 (Ed 3.3) SABS ↗
Wiring of Premises, Low Voltage Installations · Paper 1: Sections 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 7 · Annexures C, E · Paper 2: Sections 6, 8 · Annexures A, B, D, G, H, I, J, K, L, N
SANS 10292 SABS ↗
Earthing of low-voltage (LV) distribution systems · Paper 1
SANS 10198-1 SABS ↗
Selection, handling and installation of electric power cables · Part 1: Definitions and statutory requirements · Paper 1
SANS 10198-2 SABS ↗
Selection, handling and installation of electric power cables · Part 2: Selection of cable type · Paper 1 (no calculation questions)
SANS 10313 SABS ↗
Protection against lightning: Physical damage to structures and life hazard · Paper 2
SANS 1507-1 SABS ↗
Electric cables — Cables with extruded insulation for fixed wiring, 300/500 V and 450/750 V · Paper 2
SANS 1973-3 SABS ↗
Low-voltage switchgear and controlgear assemblies: Safety of assemblies with a rated prospective short-circuit current of up to and including 10 kA · Paper 2

OHS Act orders are quote-based — Tseke will confirm LexisNexis pricing and arrange payment separately.
